title: BlackRock Files for Bitcoin ETF With Downside Buffer and Capped Upside
summary: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock Files for Bitcoin ETF With Downside Buffer and Capped Upside A new filing with the SEC shows BlackRock wants to release an exchange-traded fund that offers downside protection but also caps gains. This post BlackRock Files for Bitcoin ETF With Downside Buffer and Capped Upside first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
